templates.title: Fix a bug: 〔what happens〕
templates.done: Reproduce it first, and after the fix it no longer happens; {test} passes; say what caused it and what changed

templates.title: Fix the failing tests
templates.done: Run {test} and fix what fails (fix the code under test, do not delete tests); in the end {test} all passes

templates.title: Fix the build errors
templates.done: {build} no longer fails; do not change unrelated code along the way

templates.title: Fix lint
templates.done: {lint} has no errors or warnings; change only what it points at

templates.title: Fix a crash: 〔where it crashes〕
templates.done: Find steps that reproduce it first; after the fix, following them no longer crashes; {test} passes; say what caused it

templates.title: Fix a flaky test
templates.done: Find why it is flaky (timing, order, shared state…) and fix that, not by adding retries; {test} passes several runs in a row

templates.title: Find what broke recently: 〔what happens〕
templates.done: Find the change in the history that broke it and fix it; {test} passes; say which commit and why it broke

templates.title: Test what changed recently
templates.done: Look at the recent commits and add tests for the behavior they changed; {test} passes; say which were added

templates.title: Add tests for 〔module〕
templates.done: Its main behavior and edge cases have tests; {test} passes

templates.title: Raise the coverage
templates.done: Find important code no test reaches and test it; {test} passes; say the coverage before and after

templates.title: Test the edge cases of 〔function〕
templates.done: Empty, largest and invalid inputs all have tests, and the problems they find are fixed; {test} passes

templates.title: Add a regression test for the bug just fixed
templates.done: The new test fails before the fix and passes after; {test} passes

templates.title: Make the tests faster
templates.done: Find the slowest tests and remove needless waits and repeated setup; {test} still all passes; say how much faster

templates.title: Add a feature: 〔what it does〕
templates.done: The feature works and has tests; {test} passes; say how to use it

templates.title: Add an endpoint
templates.done: The endpoint can be called, and gives clear errors for bad input; it has tests; {test} passes

templates.title: Add a page
templates.done: The page opens and shows the right things; {build} passes; say how to get there

templates.title: Add a setting: 〔what it does〕
templates.done: It has a default and old uses are unaffected; tests and docs added; {test} passes

templates.title: Add a command: 〔what it does〕
templates.done: The command runs, has help, and says why when it fails; {test} passes

templates.title: A small change: 〔what to change〕
templates.done: Change only what was asked; {test} and {lint} pass

templates.title: Refactor 〔where〕
templates.done: Same behavior, easier to read; {test} passes; say how the structure changed

templates.title: Delete dead code
templates.done: Delete functions, files and settings nobody uses; {build} and {test} pass; list what was deleted

templates.title: Make the names consistent
templates.done: One name for each concept; {build} and {test} pass; list the names changed

templates.title: Split big files
templates.done: The biggest files split by what they do, same behavior; {test} passes

templates.title: Add types, remove any
templates.done: Remove the any and type assertions that can go, and the type check passes; {test} passes; same behavior

templates.title: Merge duplicated code
templates.done: Find logic repeated in several places and keep it in one; {test} passes; same behavior

templates.title: Clear the TODOs
templates.done: Do the TODOs that can be done, and say why the rest stay; {test} passes

templates.title: Upgrade the dependencies
templates.done: Dependencies up to new compatible versions; {build} and {test} pass; list what was upgraded and any breaking changes

templates.title: Fix the security warnings
templates.done: Known vulnerabilities in dependencies fixed (upgraded or replaced); {test} passes; list what was fixed

templates.title: Remove unused dependencies
templates.done: Delete the dependencies the code does not use; {build} and {test} pass; list what was removed

templates.title: Upgrade 〔dependency〕 to the latest
templates.done: Follow its upgrade guide and fix what broke; {build} and {test} pass; say what changed

templates.title: Tidy the lock file
templates.done: The lock file matches the declared dependencies, with no duplicate versions; {build} and {test} pass

templates.title: Upgrade the runtime version
templates.done: The language or runtime up to its current stable version, configuration and CI together; {build} and {test} pass

templates.title: Say in the README how to start
templates.done: Following the README from nothing installs it, runs it and runs the tests ({test}); every command in it was run by hand

templates.title: Document 〔where〕
templates.done: Say what it does, how to use it and why it is designed so; it matches the code

templates.title: Update the changelog
templates.done: Write the changes since the last release into the changelog, split into added, fixed and changed

templates.title: Comment the hard parts
templates.done: Write only the why and what is easy to get wrong, without restating the code; {lint} passes

templates.title: Write the API docs
templates.done: Each public endpoint's parameters, results and errors written down, matching the code

templates.title: Write how to contribute
templates.done: Say how to install, run the tests and submit; following it works end to end

templates.title: Review the recent changes
templates.done: Read the recent commits and list bugs, risks and what could be simpler, each with file and line; do not change code

templates.title: Find performance problems
templates.done: Find the slowest spots, and say how they were measured, where the time goes and how to fix it; do not change code

templates.title: Look for security problems
templates.done: Look for injection, broken access control, leaked keys and the like, each with its place and severity; do not change code

templates.title: Get to know the project
templates.done: Say what the project does, how to run it and its tests ({test}), how the folders are laid out and where it is messiest; do not change code

templates.title: Check the dependencies for risks
templates.done: List outdated, advised-against and unmaintained dependencies with suggestions; do not change code

templates.title: Check the error handling
templates.done: Find where errors are swallowed, only logged, or reported unclearly, as a list; do not change code

templates.title: Find important code with no tests
templates.done: List the places most in need of tests and why; do not change code

templates.title: Get ready to release
templates.done: {build} and {test} pass, version and changelog updated; no tag, no push

templates.title: Tag a release
templates.done: Tag the next version on main's latest commit, following the existing version rules; no push; say the version and what it includes

templates.title: Write the release notes
templates.done: Write release notes from the commits since the last release: added, fixed, and changes to watch for

templates.title: Bump the version
templates.done: Bump the version by the size of the changes, the same everywhere; {build} passes

templates.title: Check before releasing
templates.done: {build}, {test} and {lint} all pass; a fresh install by the docs works; list the problems found

templates.title: Make a fix release: 〔what it fixes〕
templates.done: Only this one fix; {test} passes; release notes written
